messages:
ana: Heads-up  discovered a copy/paste footgun in the iOS sample app README (samples/mobile/ios/README.md). A developer pasted a literal API key into the Swift snippet and it landed in a public gist. Filing SUP-5055.

ben: ouch, which snippet exactly?

ana: the Swift example shows: 

```ana: import Foundation
let apiKey = "sk-EXAMPLEKEY" // DO NOT COMMIT
var request = URLRequest(url: URL(string: "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat")!)
request.addValue("Bearer \(apiKey)", forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
// naive sync call on main thread - don't do this in UI
```

clare: yikes. two problems: literal token + sync network example in UI code. Newer iOS devs will copy this straight into viewDidLoad and block the UI.

ben: plan: replace with Keychain/Environment pattern, show URLSession with timeout + async/await, and include a short section: "Prefer the SDK" that explains SDK-managed retries (429/5xx with jittered backoff), connection pooling, and how to opt out (retries: 0) for single-shot scripts.

ana: propose fixed snippet: 

```ana: // safe async Swift example
import Foundation
let apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["REDWOOD_API_KEY"] ?? ""
var request = URLRequest(url: URL(string: "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat")!)
request.addValue("Bearer \(apiKey)", forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
request.timeoutInterval = 10
let (data, response) = try await URLSession.shared.data(for: request)
```

clare: also include a short SDK example and how to disable retries in SDK config.

ben: I'll open a PR to: 1) remove the hardcoded key, 2) add the async/await + timeout example, 3) add an SDK snippet and opt-out example, and 4) add a docs CI grep that fails on patterns like `sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}` or `REPLACE_ME`.

ci-bot: Suggested CI check: `grep -R --exclude-dir=vendor -E "sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}|REPLACE_ME" docs/ samples/ || exit 1`. Extra: warn if `DispatchQueue.main.sync` or blocking patterns appear in UI samples.

ana: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912  title: "mobile/ios: remove hardcoded key, async example, SDK parity + docs-lint"

docs-bot: New PR opened by ben: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 - title: "mobile/ios: remove hardcoded key, async example, SDK parity + docs-lint"

clare: will review. after merge notify security to rotate leaked key and support so SUP-5055 can be closed. Add an author checklist item: "never paste keys in examples; prefer env/keychain/secrets."

ben: thanks  landing this afternoon. :lock:
